map.📋 PSA密度(PSAD)与穿刺指征评估器: 📋 PSA Density (PSAD) and Biopsy Indication Assessor
map.计算 PSA 密度 PSAD，结合 PSA、年龄、前列腺体积评估前列腺穿刺活检指: Calculates PSA density (PSAD) and, combining PSA, age and prostate volume, assesses the indication for prostate needle biopsy
map.PSA 密度 PSAD = 血清 PSA ÷ 前列腺体积；小于0.15 低危、0: PSA density PSAD = serum PSA ÷ prostate volume; less than 0.15 low risk, 0.15 to 0.25 intermediate risk, not below 0.25 high risk (biopsy recommended). Age-specific PSA upper limits: under 50 years 2.5, under 60 years 3.5, under 70 years 4.5, not below 70 years 6.5 ng/mL.
map.可随访复查，必要时 MRI: Follow-up recheck is fine; MRI if necessary
map.建议结合 MRI/DRE 综合判断: Comprehensive judgment combining MRI/DRE is recommended
map.① PSA>10 ng/mL；② PSA 4-10 ng/mL 且 PSAD>0:
(1) PSA > 10 ng/mL; (2) PSA 4-10 ng/mL with PSAD > 0.15, or abnormal DRE, or suspicious MRI;
(3) PSA 4-10 ng/mL with a negative initial evaluation may be rechecked with f/tPSA, PSAD and MRI before deciding. PSAD reduces false-positive PSA elevation caused by BPH.
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供临床参考，穿刺决策需医师结合影像、指检、既往史等综合判断。: ⚠️ This tool is for clinical reference only; the biopsy decision requires the physician to integrate imaging, digital rectal examination and past history.
map.📚 深度解析：PSA 密度（PSAD）与穿刺指征: 📚 Deep dive: PSA density (PSAD) and biopsy indication
map.PSA 6、体积 50mL：PSAD=6/50=0.12<0.15 低危；但年龄: PSA 6, volume 50 mL: PSAD = 6/50 = 0.12 < 0.15, low risk; but at age 65 the age limit is 4.5 and PSA 6 > 4.5, so biopsy after MRI is still recommended.
map.PSA 10、体积 33mL：PSAD=10/33=0.30>0.25 高危，直: PSA 10, volume 33 mL: PSAD = 10/33 = 0.30 > 0.25, high risk; biopsy is directly recommended.
map.年龄限怎么用？: How is the age limit used?
map.按年龄 PSA 阈值：<50→2.5、<60→3.5、<70→4.5、≥70→6: PSA thresholds by age: <50 to 2.5, <60 to 3.5, <70 to 4.5, >=70 to 6.5; when the threshold is exceeded, decide by combining PSAD, DRE and MRI.
map.PSAD 的阈值怎么定？: How is the PSAD threshold set?
map.临床常用 0.15 ng/mL/mL 作为界值：>0.15 提示临床显著癌风险升: A cutoff of 0.15 ng/mL/mL is commonly used clinically: >0.15 suggests an increased risk of clinically significant cancer, and multiparametric MRI (PI-RADS) is advised to decide on biopsy; when <0.10, biopsy can be deferred relatively safely with regular rechecks. The gray zone (0.10-0.15) requires judgment combining DRE, MRI and the PSA change rate.
